program: Wingless repaired-bridge suppression attribution under fixed future-data budget
question: For code-target motifs in zero-training-support classes 5 and 6 that are present in the target representation but never become repaired top-1, at what frozen bridge stage does their competitive rank disappear?
hypothesis: Replay the exact R4/R3 training sources, 15,819-byte budget, 256 selected motifs, 8x32 class partition, repaired relation, and 1,454-byte code target. Restrict attribution to target depth-3 query windows containing at least one raw decoded motif in classes 5 or 6. For every such query, record four byte-identical-stage diagnostics without changing prediction: (B) unrepaired base relation terminal distribution; (E) exact-pair context terminal distribution before repair selection where available; (R) final repaired terminal distribution; and (T) final repaired top-1. For classes 5/6, measure per-stage probability mass, top-1 counts, and rank of the highest-probability class member. Attribute suppression to base_relation_absence if class mass is zero at B; exact_context_suppression if positive at B but zero/noncompetitive after E; repair_selection_suppression if competitive before repair but loses rank/mass at R; or final_competition if class mass remains positive at R but no class member reaches T. No bridge, capacity, threshold, data, class, or selection rule changes.

portfolio_context.role: advisory-only; diagnostic attribution only; optimize future-data learning efficiency

prior_evidence.diagnosis: Classes 5 and 6 exist in the code target representation but are suppressed before repaired top-1; class 7 is absent and is not the focus of R5.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes; every target query selected by the frozen class-5/6 raw-presence criterion receives exactly one suppression attribution and R4's zero repaired-top1 result for classes 5 and 6 reproduces.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but one or more selected queries cannot be attributed by the frozen stage categories.
classification_rules.invalid: Any parent, authority, source, budget, representation, class, bridge-stage identity, target-query identity, determinism, provenance, or accounting criterion fails.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter R4 source identities, budgets, 256 capacity, 8x32 class partition, suppressed classes, target bytes, bridge stages, attribution rules, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_final_competition_dominates.intent: replace zero-support preflight with a target-agnostic training signal tied to competitive probability mass and test on new future data under fixed budgets

successor_otherwise.intent: factor the attributed bridge stage under fixed data/capacity before proposing any bounded mechanism
